description: This file defines a class MpesaConnector for interacting with the M-Pesa API, including authentication, balance inquiry, and initiating payment requests.

classes.name: MpesaConnector
classes.description: A class to handle authentication and API calls to M-Pesa for balance inquiries and payment processing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the connector with environment settings and URLs, and performs authentication.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Fetches and stores an access token from the M-Pesa API.

methods.name: get_balance
methods.description: Uses M-Pesa's API to query account balance for a specified till number.

methods.name: stk_push
methods.description: Initiates an M-Pesa STK push payment request for a customer.
